reason: ForkProbe primarily orchestrates comparative trials of AI skills and artifact pipelines, presenting local reports so users can select a winner and continue with it.

summaries.zh: ForkProbe 会用同一任务并排试跑多个 AI Skill 或产物流水线，生成本地报告供用户比较并选择后续执行路径。
summaries.en: ForkProbe runs multiple AI skills or artifact pipelines on the same task, produces local comparison reports, and lets users choose a path for continued execution.

capabilities: Recommends candidate skills or artifact pipelines
Runs baseline and multiple candidate workflows on the same task
Generates local HTML reports with outputs, previews, metrics, and evaluation suggestions
Supports user selection of a winning candidate and continuation handoff
Can use locally installed, GitHub, hub, or user-provided candidate paths
Supports optional artifact rendering and media quality checks
